mechanism.summary: DRAFT ONLY; no implementation authorization. One fixed-M five-stage architectural migration following docs/design/frame-activation.md and T056, not a dispatch-preamble or frame-movement leaf. M2.1: BindingPlan resolves parameter/received-cell/slot-kind/self/arguments/global-shadow facts once; CallSeed consumes caller arguments into slots once; ActivationContext owns typed caller-varying state. For callee-ordinary entries replace the entire function_env/FrameBindings/name import/export/write-back/realm refresh/direct-leaf CallEnv route, including nested Vm construction adapters. Vm borrows a services environment instead of owning a cloned CallEnv. Other entries retain one complete legacy route. Caller-ordinary and callee-ordinary are separate predicates, excluding transitively eval/with-capable closures. Native readers reborrow typed fields under an unwind-safe current-activation guard; audited native writers stay wholly legacy. No mirrored legacy name entries. M2.2: ScopeLease and lazy dynamic consumers replace remaining eval/with/deopt/name consumers; delete legacy CallEnv name storage, preserve canonical slot/cell authority. M2.3: persistent frame store plus same-Vm generic-to-generic driver together, fieldwise initialization, zero-based windows, no per-op FrameId resolution, no in-memory aggregate call/return transition or program-owner re-resolution. No generator/async leases yet. M2.4: compact windows join that store/driver, retire thread-local pool and call_from_activation adapters, clear written high-water only; mapped exits resume on their own slot, unmapped conversions counted once, declined backedges stop exiting. M2.5: route constructors, synchronous native callbacks, eval and detachable generator/async leases through the context; native capability API, zero nested Vms and no hot compatibility adapter; only this stage claims payoff. Full contracts, ownership boundaries and prior T021/T024/T027 failures are linked in the inputs.
mechanism.generality: Admission uses code metadata, slot/cell ownership, call population and transitive eval/with capability. No source/bytecode template, library/benchmark/function/property spelling, checksum, path or iteration recognizer. Preserve current tier eligibility, object/property layout, Value representation, compiler recipe, slot-indexed locals and shared upvalue cells. No per-call name-keyed snapshot, new crate/dependency, FFI or unsafe. CODE-LAYOUT RISK: M2 does not inherit a kernel firewall. Keep typed op enum/scalar sizing, object services and tier admission unchanged; do not revive T064 service-yield outlining. M2.1/2 change entry and helpers before the dispatch driver; this reduces direct hot-loop churn but fat LTO can still move typed and wide relative PCs/spills. Compare exact linked M/candidate kernels, relative block PCs, stack spills, tables and hot callees at every stage, with independent A/A where interpreting drift. Use scripts/check-kernel-isolation.sh --ref <candidate> --full --output "$BENCH_OUT/kernel-diagnostic" in a queued non-timing job when attributing cold/object coupling; it diagnoses perturbation susceptibility, is NOT an M2 pass prerequisite, and does not compare M/candidate by itself. In stages 3/4 intentional wide-driver changes are recorded separately from accidental typed-kernel drift. All six placements, instructions, complete lanes and formal gates price any coupling. No padding, winning-offset selection, golden refresh or altered recipe to hide it.
semantic_risks: Ordinary-cohort reach is not measured by sampling. Before freeze/implementation audit every NativeFunction-reachable CallEnv writer into a concrete exclusion inventory and resolve callee/caller cohorts, including eval or with nested three closures deep. The missing audit is an open draft item, not an empty writer list. M2.1 zero-work counters must prove the whole legacy route is absent rather than moved or mirrored.

Native services must retain module host/referrer/imports, private environment, with stack, catch bindings, var conflicts, deopt and new.target through guarded re-entry/unwind. After each native call assert these and frame bindings unchanged. Cover module -> indirect eval/Function -> import(), private-name isolation, with callbacks and new.target.

Preserve defaults/rest/destructuring/TDZ order, duplicate mapped parameters, immutable self, sibling/loop cells, module live cells, global deletion/accessor/recreation, cross-realm and derived-this/super. Scope leases must outlive creator frames without retaining reusable FrameIds or copied name/value authority.

No frame/program/register/RefCell borrow survives observer re-entry. Deep/mutual recursion, callbacks through accessors/Proxy/coercion/iterator, throw/finally/using, constructor substitution, generator yield*/executing rejection, await/FIFO/jobs and detachable lease lifetimes need focused coverage and full configured Test262 zero gap each stage.

PLAN/BUDGET: stages=5, current_stage=1, one cumulative M, stage cap min(1.025,B_i) manually audited on every policy case, no intermediate retain. K=6 always, five pairs per layout, workers-4 v6, 60-block canonical formal after each passing stage screen. At most two valid failed screens/stage aborts across the entire M2 migration, shared across stages, no borrowing from old M1/K or reset by stage advance. A second valid failure closes this implementation shape. Record every invocation; incomplete evidence follows frozen completion rules, never replaces adverse valid evidence. At most seven valid full screen sets and six canonical formal bundles; no repeated successful stage run for a favorable result. V6 mandatory two-look continuations to the policy cap 240, complete events/panels and load-only recovery remain inside the contract; no ad hoc extra formal look. Final 30-pair held-out acceptance, required held-out K=6 event/diagnostic completion; held-out never selects work.

RESOURCES: instruction-blind, both targets memory-sensitive. Require replayed complete resource report/raw and per-case paired process max-RSS candidate/M medians <=1.05 for all 86 selection policy cases at each stage, including every development case; no lane or generic probe substitute. Bind raw RSS samples to exact M/candidate, host, case/block identities in the formal cohort; missing coverage blocks decision. Excess blocks advance/promotion pending lead review. Record per-case allocation/env work/frame entry counts and retained buffer high-water; warm slot allocations must plateau at stages 3/4. The schema does not enforce this numeric/manual ceiling.

BEFORE EVERY STAGE: focused semantic/counter tests, check.sh, compare-qjs.sh, full configured Test262 scan with burndown and no exclusions; diagnostic instrumented binaries never time. M2.1 ordinary entries have zero call_env_constructions/frame_binding_inserts/env_write_backs/env_exports/realm_refresh_scans/argument_vectors/name_slot_lookups/native with_stack_clones; nonordinary fixtures still prove fallback. Later stage work-count and emitted-code obligations are exactly those in T056 and frame-activation. Final payoff applies independently to both targets, every pair improving and all six target medians aggregated, with every non-target a control and all lane/portfolio/instruction/precision/held-out gates unchanged.
